note: Four self-designed preset decks. Only cards whose full Simplified-Chinese rules text was verified against an official article image are used. Roles that could not be verified (evolution pre-stages without official images, the D-mark 先机球, ACE SPEC / Radiant) are excluded rather than guessed.
legality_basis: 60 cards exactly; at most 4 with the same name (counted by name_group_key, not by effect identity); basic Energy unlimited; at least 1 Basic Pokemon
regulation marks E/F/G or basic Energy (effective 2025-01-17)
past-series reprints on the official list use the newest wording (see environment JSON reprint_provision)
trainer categories and search semantics follow the 2025-01-17 Pokemon Tool / Item revision (see environment JSON card_rule_applications)
progress lines: every card with evolves_from must have its named pre-evolution in the same deck (checked by tools/card-data/build-card-data.mjs)
support_status: 所有卡牌均为资料已核实；本票不实现引擎，正式可对战须由下游实现并验收。
validation_method: node tools/card-data/build-card-data.mjs (recomputes identities, 60-card totals, same-name groups, basic Pokemon, mark legality, evolution prerequisites, matrix/detail text consistency; --write regenerates derived files)

rules_revision_notes: 宝可梦道具独立于物品（2025-01-17 起，官方公告 17144）：以「物品」为对象的检索不能选择宝可梦道具。仙子伊布V「梦中赠礼」与珠贝的「物品」检索都不能拿勇气护符/坚硬束带/一击卷轴 愤怒之卷；这些卡仍可正常放入卡组并附着。
同名 4 张限制按 name_group_key（卡名）计算；效果身份 effect_identity 与印刷身份 print_identity 另行记录（data/cards/zh-cn-standard-2025-06-05/card-identities.json）。四套卡组内没有同名异效果卡牌，也没有跨印次合并效果身份。
进化前置：仙子伊布VMAX 需要卡组内的仙子伊布V；校验脚本会检查每一张有进化前置的卡。
